prompt.system: You are an expert annotator of emotions in TV-show dialogue.
prompt.question: Which emotion does {who} express in the last line? Answer with one word: neutral, surprise, fear, sadness, joy, disgust, or anger.
prompt.context: past turns and the target, "Speaker k: text", generic speaker labels

scoring: next-token log-probabilities of the first tokens of each label word (4 spellings), log-sum-exp per class, renormalised over the seven classes
calibration: prior matching: p~ ∝ p / q * prior_train, q = the LLM's mean prediction on the dev inputs (label-free), frozen before the test
fusion: score = (1 - w) log p_ECERC + w log p~_LLM
selection: highest mean dev macro-F1 over the three checkpoints; ties to the smaller w
secondary: fusion without calibration (its own dev-chosen w; test-only CI)
pilot: dev-only pilot with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (2026-10-19), see PROTOCOL.md

criteria.primary: mean over the three released checkpoints of test macro-F1(fused) - macro-F1(ECERC alone), in points
success: mean F1 change > 0 for Fear and for Disgust
delta > 0 in at least 70% of pairs
